description.sr:
Metoda `filter` prolazi kroz niz i pravi nov niz samo od elemenata za koje funkcija koju joj damo vrati `true`. Na primer, `[1, 2, 3, 4].filter((n) => n > 2)` daje `[3, 4]`. Ostali elementi se izostavljaju, a redosled onih koji ostanu je isti.

Napiši funkciju `longWords(words, min)` koja vraća reči koje imaju bar `min` slova.

`words` je niz tekstova, a `min` je ceo broj, `0` ili veći. Funkcija vraća novi niz tekstova.

Pravila:
- reč koja ima tačno `min` slova ulazi u rezultat
- ako nijedna reč ne ulazi, rezultat je prazan niz `[]`
- redosled reči ostaje kao u ulazu
- originalni niz se ne menja

Primeri:
- `longWords(['a', 'bb', 'ccc', 'dd'], 2)` → `['bb', 'ccc', 'dd']`
- `longWords(['cat', 'house'], 4)` → `['house']`
- `longWords(['cat', 'dog'], 3)` → `['cat', 'dog']`, jer reč sa tačno 3 slova ulazi
- `longWords(['a', 'b'], 5)` → `[]`
- `longWords(['', 'a'], 0)` → `['', 'a']`, jer svaka reč ima bar 0 slova
description.en:
The `filter` method goes through an array and creates a new array only from the elements for which the function we give it returns `true`. For example, `[1, 2, 3, 4].filter((n) => n > 2)` gives `[3, 4]`. The other elements are left out, and the order of those that stay is the same.

Write a function `longWords(words, min)` that returns the words that have at least `min` letters.

`words` is an array of texts and `min` is a whole number, `0` or more. The function returns a new array of texts.

Rules:
- a word with exactly `min` letters goes into the result
- if no word goes in, the result is an empty array `[]`
- the order of the words stays as in the input
- the original array is not changed

Examples:
- `longWords(['a', 'bb', 'ccc', 'dd'], 2)` → `['bb', 'ccc', 'dd']`
- `longWords(['cat', 'house'], 4)` → `['house']`
- `longWords(['cat', 'dog'], 3)` → `['cat', 'dog']`, because a word with exactly 3 letters goes in
- `longWords(['a', 'b'], 5)` → `[]`
- `longWords(['', 'a'], 0)` → `['', 'a']`, because every word has at least 0 letters

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function longWords` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(words, min)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `words` je niz tekstova, `min` je najmanji dozvoljeni broj slova. Poziv `longWords(['a', 'bb'], 2)` daje `words = ['a', 'bb']` i `min = 2`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 3.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function longWords` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(words, min)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `words` is the array of texts, `min` is the smallest allowed number of letters. The call `longWords(['a', 'bb'], 2)` gives `words = ['a', 'bb']` and `min = 2`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 3 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Cela obrada je u jednoj liniji.

- `words.filter(...)` poziva metodu `filter` nad nizom `words` i pravi **nov** niz. Original se ne menja.
- `(word) => word.length >= min` je uslov koji dajemo metodi `filter`. Za svaki element `word` vraća `true` ili `false`.
- `>=` znači „veće ili jednako“. Zato reč sa tačno `min` slova prolazi. Sa `>` bi ispala, a to bi bila greška.
- `filter` zadržava elemente za koje je odgovor `true`, redom kojim su bili u nizu.
- Ako nijedan ne prođe, `filter` vraća prazan niz `[]`.
- `min` je dostupno unutar strelice jer je ona napisana unutar funkcije `longWords`.

```
words = ['cat', 'dog', 'house'], min = 4
'cat'   → 3 >= 4 → false (ispada)
'dog'   → 3 >= 4 → false (ispada)
'house' → 5 >= 4 → true  (ostaje)
rezultat: ['house']
```
text.en:
The whole processing is on one line.

- `words.filter(...)` calls the `filter` method on the array `words` and creates a **new** array. The original is not changed.
- `(word) => word.length >= min` is the condition we give to `filter`. For every element `word` it returns `true` or `false`.
- `>=` means “greater than or equal”. That is why a word with exactly `min` letters passes. With `>` it would drop out, and that would be a mistake.
- `filter` keeps the elements for which the answer is `true`, in the order they had in the array.
- If none passes, `filter` returns an empty array `[]`.
- `min` is available inside the arrow because it is written inside the function `longWords`.

```
words = ['cat', 'dog', 'house'], min = 4
'cat'   → 3 >= 4 → false (dropped)
'dog'   → 3 >= 4 → false (dropped)
'house' → 5 >= 4 → true  (stays)
result: ['house']
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Najkraće. `filter` vraća prazan niz kad ništa ne prođe, pa nema posebnog slučaja.
note.en: The shortest. `filter` returns an empty array when nothing passes, so there is no special case.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan niz za reči koje prođu.

- `const` jer se promenljiva `result` ne dodeljuje ponovo; sadržaj niza se menja.
- Ako nijedna reč ne prođe, upravo ovaj prazan niz se vraća.
text.en:
We create an empty array for the words that pass.

- `const` because the variable `result` is not assigned again; the contents of the array change.
- If no word passes, exactly this empty array is returned.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz sve reči redom.

- `for (const word of words)` znači: za svaki element niza `words`, redom, uradi telo petlje. U svakom krugu `word` je jedna reč.
- Zato redosled u rezultatu ostaje isti kao u ulazu.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 5.
text.en:
We go through all the words in order.

- `for (const word of words)` means: for every element of the array `words`, in order, run the loop body. In every round `word` is one word.
- That is why the order in the result stays the same as in the input.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 5.

text.sr:
Dodajemo reč u rezultat samo ako je dovoljno dugačka.

- `word.length >= min` je uslov: da li reč ima bar `min` slova. `>=` znači „veće ili jednako“, pa reč sa tačno `min` slova prolazi.
- `if` bez vitičastih zagrada: u njega spada tačno jedna naredba posle uslova.
- `result.push(word)` dodaje reč na kraj niza `result`.

```
words = ['cat', 'dog', 'house'], min = 4
krug  word     uslov     result posle kruga
1     'cat'    3>=4 ne   []
2     'dog'    3>=4 ne   []
3     'house'  5>=4 da   ['house']
```
text.en:
We add the word to the result only if it is long enough.

- `word.length >= min` is the condition: does the word have at least `min` letters. `>=` means “greater than or equal”, so a word with exactly `min` letters passes.
- `if` without curly braces: exactly one statement after the condition belongs to it.
- `result.push(word)` adds the word to the end of the array `result`.

```
words = ['cat', 'dog', 'house'], min = 4
round  word     condition  result after the round
1      'cat'    3>=4 no    []
2      'dog'    3>=4 no    []
3      'house'  5>=4 yes   ['house']
```
